sources.title: Entry Arrangements for Mainland, Macao, Taiwan & Overseas Chinese Residents
sources.publisher: Immigration Department, Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Immigration Department special-arrangements page, revised 2 June 2026, separately specifies Macao resident-document arrangements, Macao SAR passport transit, and conditional Taiwan-resident entry routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Holders of Macao SAR passports and holders of Macao SAR Travel Permits may transit Hong Kong for a stay up to 7 days.

sources.title: Pre-arrival Registration for Taiwan Residents
sources.publisher: Immigration Department, Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Immigration Department page identifies PAR eligibility by Taiwan-resident birth/admission history and travel-document attributes, rather than an ordinary Taiwan passport alone.
sources.supportingExcerpt: were born in Taiwan; or were born outside Taiwan but have been admitted to Hong Kong as a Taiwan resident before

unresolved.reason: The current Immigration Department foreign-country dataset has no direct Kosovo ordinary-passport row. Its residual other-foreign-countries row is not used to infer passport recognition, a waiver or issuance timing.

Current Hong Kong rules grant visit concessions by Macao resident identity card or Visit Permit, while Macao SAR passports are directly covered only for qualifying seven-day transit. Neither establishes an ordinary Macao SAR passport visitor baseline.

Current Taiwan PAR and entry-permit routes depend on Chinese-resident status, birthplace or prior Taiwan-resident admission, and permitted travel documents. Those personal conditions cannot establish one ordinary Taiwan-passport visitor baseline.
The current Immigration Department foreign-country dataset has no direct Timor-Leste ordinary-passport row. Its residual other-foreign-countries row is not used to infer a waiver or issuance timing.
